def test_frame_extraction(video_path, frame_number):
    import subprocess
    command = [
        'ffmpeg',
        '-i', video_path,
        '-vf', f'select=eq(n\,{frame_number})',
        '-vframes', '1',
        'output_frame.png'
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        print(f"Frame {frame_number} extracted successfully.")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print(f"Failed to extract frame {frame_number}.")
